title: THE DRAGON'S CURSE
intro:
You awaken in your cottage with a pounding headache.
Sunlight streams through the window, but something feels... wrong.
The air is thick with an unnatural silence.

You remember fragments of last night - a massive shadow passing
overhead, screams from the village, and a deep, rumbling roar
that shook the very foundations of your home.

cottage.name: Your Cottage
cottage.desc: A cozy cottage with a fireplace. The wooden floor creaks beneath your feet.
cottage.story: Your home feels emptier than usual. Something terrible has happened.

forest.name: Ancient Forest
forest.desc: A winding path through tall pine trees. Sunlight filters through the canopy. To the west, a rusted iron gate guards the mouth of a cave.
forest.story: The forest is eerily quiet. No birds sing.

west.msg: The iron gate is locked. Its old lock is caked with rust.
west.openMsg: The rusty key turns with a groan, and the iron gate swings open.

clearing.name: Moonlit Clearing
clearing.desc: An open clearing with wildflowers. A small stream babbles nearby.
clearing.story: The merchant's cart sits abandoned. He must have fled in terror.

cave.name: Shadow Cave
cave.desc: A damp cave with moss-covered walls. It's quite dark in here. To the north, a wall of living shadow seals a passage.
cave.story: You sense dark magic at work here. The dragon's minions lurk within.

north.msg: The wall of shadow pushes you back. No mortal light could pierce it.
north.openMsg: The Crown of Light blazes in your hands. The shadows shriek and part before you.

lair.name: Dragon's Lair
lair.desc: A massive cavern filled with treasure and bones. The air reeks of sulfur.
lair.story: This is it - the dragon's lair. You feel its malevolent presence.

key.desc: A rusty old key. It looks like it might open a gate.

stone.desc: A smooth river stone. Nothing special about it.

book.desc: The Ancient Grimoire - a leather-bound tome crackling with arcane power. Protective runes shimmer across its pages.
onTake: *** The ancient book pulses with magical energy in your hands. ***
*** Perhaps the wizard would know more about this... ***

sword.desc: The Blessed Sword - forged by holy knights to slay evil creatures.
onTake: *** The sword gleams with holy light. This is no ordinary weapon! ***

crown.desc: The Crown of Light - radiates divine energy that weakens dark magic.
onTake: *** The crown is warm to the touch. Its light pushes the shadows back. ***

axe.desc: A heavy battle axe stained with ancient blood.

wizard.desc: An old wizard with a long grey beard.

initial: Greetings, traveler. Something terrible has happened to our land.
Please, speak with me. I have urgent news!
questGiven: The Ancient Grimoire lies in the clearing to the east.
The Blessed Sword is hidden in the cave to the west. The gate is locked - but you keep an old key at home, don't you?
A skeleton warrior in that cave stole the Crown of Light from the old shrine.
Only the Crown's light can break the shadow that seals the dragon's lair.
Gather them all, and you will have the power to defeat the beast!

onFirstTalk: "Last night, an ancient dragon awakened. It has cursed our land!"
"To defeat it, you must gather three legendary artifacts:"
"The Ancient Grimoire, the Blessed Sword, and the Crown of Light."
"But beware - the dragon's minions guard the path to its lair!"

merchant.desc: A cheerful merchant with a cart.

initial: Oh thank goodness someone is here!
Take whatever you need from my cart. We must stop that beast!

onFirstTalk: "If you're going after the dragon, you'll need supplies!"
"I left a healing elixir here. Take it - you'll need it!"

goblin.desc: A vicious goblin corrupted by dark magic.

skeleton.desc: An animated skeleton warrior wreathed in shadow. Something glints inside its ribcage.
onDefeat: The skeleton crumbles into a heap of bones.
Something golden rolls out of its ribcage...

dragon.desc: A massive ancient dragon with scales like obsidian!
onDefeat: The dragon collapses with a thunderous crash!
Its dark magic dissipates into the air.
The curse on the land is lifted!

quest.name: The Dragon's Curse
quest.desc: Gather the three legendary artifacts and defeat the ancient dragon.

objectives.text: Talk to the wizard in the forest

allArtifacts: *** You have gathered all three legendary artifacts! ***
*** You feel their power coursing through you. ***
*** You are ready to face the dragon! ***
gameOver: You have been defeated! Game Over.
The dragon's curse remains over the land...
